strategyThesis: Prioritize one shared data foundation that two journey use cases can consume by Q4 2027, deferring property-by-property app rebuilds and a second major platform initiative in H1. Success hinges on achieving 80% consented identity coverage in two pilots by 31 Dec, with named business owners adopting the data standard.
